thread:
Raj Patel: FYI—after cilium 1.25.0 rollout to us-west2-gpu we're seeing a sharp uptick in east-west packet drops and RDMA handshake failures. Affected: tf-training pods, repr runner jobs. Starting this thread to coordinate checks.

Priya Shah: +1 seeing it. Telemetry shows retransmits up ~4x, tail latency for small RPCs spikes. Job logs show 'rdma_cm: connect error -22' intermittently. :eyes: 

Mateo Rivera: I ran quick iperf3 between two GPU nodes: throughput fluctuates and stalls. baseline 38G -> dips to 1-2G for short periods. MTU probe shows some fragments. suspect tunneling/GSO interaction.

Leah Kim: Can you paste the cilium-agent logs from a failing node? IIRC 1.25 changed some offload defaults.

Raj Patel: pasted logs to gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcd1234 — key snippet:
```
Aug 18 10:12:44 cilium-agent[1234]: level=warn msg="GSO frags detected on geneve" ... offload=false
Aug 18 10:12:45 kernel: [12345.678901] cilium: tpacket recv: short packet
```

Priya Shah: Also ran tc qdisc dump — saw repeated KERNEL drop counters on vxlan interface. Command I used:
```
ssh node-12 "tc -s qdisc show dev vxlan0"
```

Jordan Hayes: oncall: rolling back cilium in canary cluster (us-west2-canary) to 1.24.3 now. Will monitor. :white_check_mark: 

Infra-bot: Deploy start: rollback cilium -> 1.24.3; rollout id=rb-2245001240; initiated by Jordan Hayes

Mateo Rivera: While rollback runs, can someone capture tcpdump on a failing pod host? tcpdump -i any -w /tmp/west2.pcap 'ip and not port 22' — I want to check RSTs and fragmentation.

Leah Kim: grabbing pcap now. Also re-running rdma pingpong test: `rping -s` — results show connect timeout during peak.

Priya Shah: Quick check: kernel versions on nodes? I saw nodes on the updated pool are 6.1.19, others 5.15.9 — could be interplay with GSO/ GRO fixes. List: `uname -r` shows the divergence.

Raj Patel: Good catch — upgraded kernel + cilium 1.25 may be interacting. Filed infra ticket INFRA-4821 to track node upgrades + cilium change.

Jordan Hayes: Canary rollback completed. Telemetry: retransmits dropped ~80% in canary in 15m. I'll schedule full rollback if staging confirms.

Priya Shah: Repro steps for postmortem: 1) cilium 1.25 -> default bpf/gso change 2) kernel 6.1 with new GSO path 3) RDMA SCTP/UDP flows on geneve/vxlan affected. Need to test with geneve vs vxlan explicitly.

Raj Patel: Action items: - Leah to upload pcaps & iperf results to ticket - Mateo to run controlled RDMA test across kernel versions - Jordan to coordinate rollback schedule for us-west2-gpu - Priya to draft blameless postmortem and perf graphs.

Leah Kim: PCAPs uploaded: https://files.redwood/incoming/west2.pcap (20MB). I annotated timestamps with observed RDMA failures.

Infra-bot: Incident update: issue severity P2; affected jobs degraded but user-facing API unaffected. Next update in 30m.

Raj Patel: Thanks everyone. If rollback across region needed, we'll sync with GFE to avoid capacity impact. :thumbsup:
